title: Holy War
text: “Eagle Piercing Shot!”

Itsuki has locked onto my Father with pinpoint accuracy. If I recall correctly, that’s a skill with piercing capabilities. It’s a troublesome attack—even Father’s formidable Defense Power is useless against this kind of skill. However, he’s been putting the enhancement methods I taught him into practice, and he’s even imbued his shield with a property that deflects those kinds of troublesome abilities, hasn’t he?
“Air One-Way Shield!”
My Father deflected the penetrating skill Itsuki fired by creating a shield that redirected its path.
“Itsuki! Please, just listen to me. We don’t have time for a war like this!”
“You’re being repetitive!”

It seems I’ll have to beat him up just enough to hurt him—but not kill him—to shut him up. It seems he won’t listen unless he knows who’s in charge. No, actually, if he suffers a defeat here, he might be more willing to listen to Father. It would be best for him to experience firsthand the overwhelming difference in strength that exists here. But if I use Skills with too much firepower, I’ll end up killing him.
“That’s right. This is a holy war.”

When the Pope brandished his fake weapon and thrust it into the ground, the Continental Cleft opened up right here. While everyone managed to dodge it, magma erupted from the ground right at your Father’s feet.
“Whoa!”

Your Father blocked it with his shield. Not a single scratch on him. By the way, the skill that caused the Continental Cleft is called “Earth Ignition.” Back in the game, it was a skill that randomly created Continental Clefts around the user to deal damage. It seems you can also direct it to target just one side if you pay attention to the direction.
“Now, the time has come to vanquish the evil Shield Demon right here… Everyone, begin chanting the Judgment spell!”
“Don’t let those Melromarc guys get the better of us! We’re starting our Ceremonial Magic as well!”
The Shusaku clan representative and Yuki-chan and the others began casting supportive Ceremonial Magic from the rear.
“Naofumi, are you okay?”
Sakura-chan ran over to my Father.
“Yeah, I’m fine. You be careful too, Sakura-chan.”
“Sakura’s a little angry, too.”
Sakura-chan struck a pose that Filo-tan often uses. Kou is kicking at the Melromarc soldiers, sweeping them aside like a bowling ball.
“Here we go—strike!”

Huh? Sakura-chan’s attack seems similar to Filo-tan’s, yet it feels different. She sped past the Melromarc soldiers lining the path to the Pope. She was brushing them aside one after another, as if she were flicking dust off her wings.
“Motoyasu, the path is clear now.”

The moment Sakura-chan turned around, the Melromarc soldiers collapsed on the spot, spitting up blood. Well, that’s only to be expected—she was flying past at high speed, and her attack completely obliterated anyone in her direct path.
“Thank you very much.”
The most troublesome opponent here is the Pope, after all. I’ll take him out while I have the chance. Just as I took a step forward, reinforcements from the rear of the Melromarc army arrived.
“Oh, reinforcements of my Melromarc! Destroy the Demon of Shields and Spears!”
But the reinforcements… attacked the Melromarc army.
“W-what?! Why?! Why are my own Melromarc men attacking their comrades?!”
“Oink!?”
Trash and Crimson Swine’s voices cracked, and I heard them utter sounds of utter disbelief.
“It’s because you aren’t part of the Melromarc army!”
A knight on horseback, accompanied by an elderly man of the Genmu race, cut through the Melromarc soldiers and rode toward my Father and the others. Oh my, look at that…
“Eclair-san!”
“I’m sorry. I was late coming to your aid.”
“Why are you here? Didn’t you go to Faubrey?”
“Of course. I went there and explained everything to the Queen of Melromarc—the state of the nation, the circumstances surrounding the Hero’s summoning, and the King’s atrocities.”
Trash seems to be watching this from afar; he’s calling out to us with a voice full of loathing.
“You’re Eclair! How dare you, traitor, show your face leading the Melromarc Army!”
“As I mentioned earlier, you are not the Melromarc Army! You’re nothing but a cult! I declare this here on behalf of the Queen!”
Éclair unfurled a parchment and held the projection crystal high. Then, the Queen’s image materialized from the crystal.

“In this conflict, there is no group within our country claiming to be the Melromarc Army. My Melromarc Army will spare no effort in subduing those bandits… together with Siltvelt. At the same time, I hereby declare that we are at odds with the Shieldfreeden Army!”
The Queen’s image vanished the moment she finished speaking.
“Wh—what nonsense… Are you saying my wife has betrayed me?! Impossible! Absolutely impossible!”

“…The Queen of Melromarc has declared that you are an imposter posing as the Wise King of Wisdom… I’ve been told that the real Wise King of Wisdom is still at Melromarc Castle, and I have been ordered to capture the imposter and bring him back to the homeland.”
Trash let out a cry as if he couldn’t believe it, and shouted:
“That guy is the imposter! Soldiers of Melromarc and members of the Three Heroes Church! Annihilate the fake Melromarc army!”
I can hear the battle cries.
“…I guess I have no choice.”
Éclair stood next to me and whispered in my ear.
“Lord Kitamura, I beg of you. With that godlike strength of yours, prove to the world that there’s no time for conflict.”
But at the same time, it seems there’s been a change in Itsuki’s demeanor.
“So that’s what he says. Itsuki, do you know which side is right now?”
When Father spoke to him, Itsuki took a step back and seemed flustered.
“U… No! Aultcray is right—you’re the villains! I’ll send you to the afterlife right here!”
He’s utterly foolish. Oops, the Pope’s Magic is nearly complete behind him. I, Motoyasu, will hurry through the path Sakura-chan has opened.
“You’re an imposter of the Spear. The sin of impersonating a god is grave… Be destroyed in the name of God!”
The Pope, triumphant, unleashed Brionac.
“Hmph.”

But after all, it’s just a fake weapon. Its power is way too weak. I deflected it with my spear, changed its course, and sent it crashing into the Three Heroes Church members who were in the middle of casting Ceremonial Magic.
“‘Waaaaaaaaaaah!’”
“‘Ooogggghhhhhhhhhhhhhh!’”
I can hear the satisfying screams of those pigs. The Pope stares at me, his eyes wide with disbelief.
“Do you understand now? You’re not welcome here.”
I grabbed the Pope by the collar, flung him upward, and unleashed the spear skill I’d been charging.
“Brionac X!”
“Guh—oh, God—”
I reduced the Pope—along with his fake weapon—to a pile of charcoal. Seeing that, the members of the Three Heroes Church were left speechless.
“The Pope… so easily…”
“N-no, the Pope is just pretending to be defeated. He’ll descend upon this land again in no time! Everyone, pray!”
And with that, they began some sort of prayer that was really just an escape from reality.
“If praying can bring about a miracle, they might as well keep at it forever.”

Huh? Come to think of it, Itsuki is fighting my Father right behind me. The real Melromarc Army and the fake Melromarc Army—along with the Three Heroes Church—are clearly separated from one another. This makes them easy to defeat.

“Lord Kitamura, I’ve received orders to capture the ringleader claiming to be Aultcray alive. If he dies, the Seven Star Weapons will fly away and expose the real one. That would threaten the very survival of the nation of Melromarc. I know you’ll be unhappy about this… but please.”
“Understood! Aiming Lancer X!”

I focused my consciousness on my spear and unleashed the Skills. The multi-lock function activated, causing enemy troops all over the battlefield to glow. Soon, the Lokk was complete, and I fired the attack over a wide area, piercing through the fake Melromarc army and the followers of the Three Heroes Church.
“‘Ughaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!’”
The Aiming Lancer rained down on the battlefield like a shower of meteors, leading the fake Melromarc army to annihilation.
“Air Strike Javelin!”
All that’s left is to mow down the remaining enemies.
“Ceremonial Magic: ‘Typhoon!’”

By then, the Ceremonial Magic chanted by Yuki-chan and the others had taken shape, systematically eliminating the remaining fake Melromarc forces. The Siltvelt Army is also putting up a good fight; they’ve left the fake Melromarc Army to the real Melromarc Army and are now battling the Shieldfreeden Army. All that’s left are the Trash at the main camp. I can see the Trash, speechless, surrounded by his soldiers.
“Not yet! We haven’t lost yet!”
It looks like Itsuki is preparing to use his Skills again, undeterred.
